Privacy

Short version: we only store what's needed to send you the newsletter.

Get the 26D checklist now: what switches on by itself, which former opt-ins are now standard, what to test

Inside the free 26D checklist (PDF):

  • The 23 opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D: 9 switch on for everyone, 14 need setup
  • 9 HCM Redwood default switches and other HCM notices for 26D
  • 9 baseline regression checks, plus typical 26D test and production dates by cohort

Then one plain-English email per Oracle quarterly update, linked to Oracle's docs. Free. 4 emails a year plus short opt-in alerts. Unsubscribe anytime. Read issue #1 (26C) → · Privacy

What we store when you subscribe

  • Your email address
  • The module area you picked (e.g. Supply Chain or HCM)
  • When you signed up
  • A one-way hash of your IP address, kept only to limit spam signups (we never store the IP address itself)

How we use it

Only to send the Fusion Updates newsletter (about one email per Oracle quarterly update, plus occasional short alerts about opt-in expirations). We don't sell or share your data, and we don't add you to other lists.

Where it's kept

Subscriber data is stored with Supabase (EU region, Frankfurt), and newsletters are sent with Resend (EU region). Both act as processors for us.

Unsubscribe and deletion

Every email has a one-click unsubscribe link. To have your data deleted, or for any question, write to hello@fusionupdates.com.

Analytics

This site uses no cookies, and newsletter open and click tracking is turned off. We count page views without cookies: for each day we keep only totals per page, the domain of the site that linked to it (for example linkedin.com), and any utm_ tags in the link. No IP address, browser details or identifier is stored, so a visit can't be traced back to you. If your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control, nothing is counted. The counter data is stored with Supabase (EU region, Frankfurt).

Fusion Updates is an independent publication. Questions about your data: hello@fusionupdates.com. Last updated: October 2026.
